metadata.title: Prisma · Psychological assessment for HR teams
metadata.description: Run validated psychological tests and questionnaires, score them automatically and review results for your team.

hero.eyebrow: For HR teams and workplace psychologists
hero.title: Understand your people, not just their CVs
hero.subtitle: Run established psychological tests and questionnaires online. Scores are calculated the moment someone finishes, and every result lands in one private workspace.

features.title: Everything an assessment day needs
features.subtitle: From the first invitation to the final report, without paper forms or spreadsheets.

library.title: Ready-made library
library.text: 19 established tests and 3 questionnaires, from anxiety and depression screening to leadership and cognitive ability, in English and Russian.

scoring.title: Automatic scoring
scoring.text: Raw scores, T-scores and stens are calculated on submit, with an interpretation for every scale.

reports.title: Per-person reports
reports.text: See all of a person's results side by side, add background and a conclusion, then print or archive.

groups.title: Teams and follow-up
groups.text: Organise people by team, and let psychologists privately flag anyone who may need support.

trust.title: Built for sensitive data
trust.subtitle: Psychological results deserve more care than an ordinary HR form.

consent.title: Consent first
consent.text: People read a plain-language privacy notice and agree to it before their first test.

access.title: Private by default
access.text: Only workspace admins see answers and scores. Colleagues never do.

judgement.title: Support, not diagnosis
judgement.text: Results inform a qualified specialist's judgement and never replace it.

import.title: Pick or import instruments
import.text: Use the built-in library or upload your own tests and questionnaires from an Excel template.

invite.title: People take them online
invite.text: Employees and candidates sign up and complete assessments from any browser, at their own pace.

review.title: Review results
review.text: Scores and interpretations are ready in the dashboard as soon as someone finishes.

cta.title: Ready to run your first assessment?
cta.text: Sign up takes a minute. Your administrator can then assign tests and questionnaires.

footer.tagline: Prisma · psychological assessment for HR teams
footer.disclaimer: Results support, and never replace, a qualified psychologist's judgement.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: Prisma is used by your organization to run psychological questionnaires and tests. This notice explains what is collected, who can see it and what you can do about it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.text: Your profile (name, email, date of birth, team, position and, if an administrator adds one, a photo), the answers you give, and the scores and interpretations calculated from them.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.text: To support hiring, development and well-being decisions in your organization. Results are one input for a qualified specialist and are never a medical diagnosis on their own.

access.title: Who can see it
access.text: Only people your organization authorises, such as HR specialists and psychologists. Results of clinical and wellbeing screens are visible only to psychologists. Other employees cannot see your answers or results.

storage.title: How long it is kept
storage.text: Until you leave the organization or an administrator removes you. Removing you deletes your answers and results in that organization.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.text: Taking part is voluntary. You can stop any questionnaire or test before finishing it, and you can ask your HR team to show, correct or delete your data.

privacy.controller: Your organization is responsible for how this data is used. Contact your HR team with any questions.
